_comment: One entry per fact that must have a single home: {"id": "build-server-region", "owner": "infra/build-server", "canonical": "region east-a", "forbidden": ["region west-b"]}. owner is the note that states the fact; canonical is the text it must keep stating; forbidden lists stale or competing versions that may appear nowhere else in the KB or in the always-loaded files (history records and lines marked SUPERSEDED are exempt). kb_health.py facts checks it; see README.md.
